entities.summary: Hanna Dmyterko or Anna Dmiterko and later also known as Hanna Ratych, was a Ukrainian soldier during World War I. She became a sergeant in the Ukrainian Sich Riflemen, a unit in the Austro-Hungarian Army. Her exploits were reported in the press, and she was decorated.
